manual_ui: Browser Play, Pause, Capture with inspector control disabled displays accepted tick/revision and downloadable PNG/identity JSON.
Actual native and browser capture PNGs inspected, including depth occlusion, visible front pose, perspective far pose and completion HUD.
limitations: No physical device-loss event was forced; failure policy branches are unit-tested.
No portable exact 3D image hash is claimed.
Other native operating systems are compile targets, not locally GPU-verified.
Browser evidence was retained using a temporary loopback-only JSON receiver at publication; committed test-page assertions and WASM were unchanged. Normal browsers can use the download link.
